title: Standard 7-Day Return Policy
description: Customers are entitled to request a return or replacement for any laptop purchased from VoltKart within 7 calendar days of delivery. To be eligible for a return the device must be in original condition with the outer box security seals intact and all packaged accessories including original power adapter user manuals and warranty cards present. Devices showing signs of customer misuse liquid damage or external drops are not eligible for return.
keywords: return policy; 7 days; eligibility; conditions; replacement

title: Refund Processing and Disbursement Policy
description: Approved returns are inspected within 48 hours of warehouse receipt. Upon verification refunds are initiated immediately to the original payment channel. For UPI and Debit Card purchases funds reflect in 3 to 5 business days. For Credit Card transactions funds reflect within 5 to 7 business days depending on the issuing bank statement cycle. Shipping charges are fully refunded for defective units.
keywords: refund timeline; bank credit; money return; payment reversal

title: Brand Manufacturer Warranty Terms
description: Every laptop sold on VoltKart comes bundled with official manufacturer warranty coverage ranging from 1 to 3 years. The warranty covers motherboard repairs processor issues display panel defects and internal keyboard or trackpad failures occurring under normal operational conditions. The warranty does not cover accidental liquid spills unauthorized repairs or cosmetic scratches.
keywords: warranty terms; coverage; repairs; official warranty; hardware defects

title: Domestic Shipping and Delivery Guidelines
description: VoltKart provides complimentary insured door-to-door courier shipping throughout India via Bluedart and Delhivery. All shipments require an OTP verification at the time of delivery to ensure secure handover. Orders placed before 2 PM IST are dispatched on the same business day. Delivery timelines range from 2 to 5 business days based on destination zone.
keywords: shipping guidelines; delivery process; otp verification; transit insurance; dispatch

title: VoltKart Domain Scope and Product Policy
description: VoltKart operates exclusively as a specialized computer retailer focusing on laptop computers mobile workstations gaming rigs and official manufacturer accessories. VoltKart does not retail mobile phones tablets televisions home audio or general consumer electronics.
